summary: NFT Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting results of an extraordinary general meeting held on April 17, 2026, where shareholders approved a share capital reduction and reorganization. The plan reduces par value of issued Class A and B ordinary shares from $0.005 to $0.0005 via cancellation of $0.0045 paid-up capital per share, transfers the credit to a distributable reserve, subdivides authorized unissued shares 10-for-1, cancels unissued shares to set authorized capital at $50,000 (90M Class A, 10M Class B shares at $0.0005 par each), subject to Cayman Companies Act solvency requirements. This is a balance-sheet restructuring, not a capital return or spin-off. Watch for subsequent use of the distributable reserve for dividends or loss offset.
